title: RedBlink Technologies
description: redblink.com RedBlink Technologies is an AI and software development company founded in 2008 in Danville, California, with over 150 employees across a hybrid onshore/offshore model spanning the US, India, Canada, Italy and Dubai. It specializes in generative AI, machine learning, NLP, AI chatbots, web and mobile development, cloud, DevOps and AI-powered SEO services. Led by Director of Delivery Sahil Aggarwal and Director Bahadur Singh, it serves healthcare, retail and technology clients from startups to enterprises. Revenue is estimated at 10 to 25 million dollars with competitive rates around 15 dollars per hour thanks to its India-based development center in SAS Nagar. Its tech stack includes Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, React, Node.js, AWS and fine-tuned LLM models like BERT and GPT. The company is self-funded with no external investors and offers rapid staff augmentation including ChatGPT developers within 48 hours.
